{# Per-profile chat room. A self-contained minimal IRC-over-WebSocket client (no third-party libraries or branding) that auto-connects over wss to the site's chat backend and auto-joins this profile's room (#profile-). Logged-in visitors chat under their slip name; everyone else gets a throwaway anon- nick. It shows who is in the room with a live count, and the profile owner can theme it (light/dark + accent colour) from profile settings. It looks like a plain chat box; the IRC backend cloaks every user so real IP addresses are never exposed. #}
